how.title: How It Works in 4 Easy Steps

step1.title: 1. Universities Create
step1.simple: Like issuing a traditional diploma, but digital
step1.desc: College administrators fill out a simple form with student details and degree information. The system creates a secure digital credential and stores it permanently. It's as easy as filling out a form, but much more secure than paper.

step2.title: 2. Students Receive
step2.simple: Your diploma lives in your digital wallet
step2.desc: The credential is sent directly to the student's digital wallet. Think of it like a digital safe that only the student controls. This is a 'soulbound token' - a special certificate that's permanently linked to the student and cannot be transferred, lost, or forged.

step3.title: 3. Employers Verify
step3.simple: Instant verification, no phone calls needed
step3.desc: Employers simply scan a QR code with their phone or enter a credential ID on our website. In seconds, they see proof that the credential is genuine - like checking a blockchain receipt. No need to call the university, no waiting, and no chance of fraud.

step4.title: 4. Anyone Verifies
step4.simple: Scan the QR to confirm the degree is real in under 5 seconds.
step4.desc: Scan the QR to confirm the degree is real in under 5 seconds.

architecture.title: System Architecture Overview
architecture.description: TrustDegree uses a decentralized architecture with clear separation of concerns across four main layers:
architecture.keyDesign: Key Design Principle: All trust anchors live on the public blockchain. Even if our servers go down, credentials remain verifiable through the blockchain and IPFS.

components.frontend: Frontend Application (React): Responsive web app with public pages (Home, Verify) and admin-only dashboard
components.backend: Backend API (Express.js): REST API handling authentication, data validation, and blockchain interactions
components.contract: Smart Contract (Solidity): Deployed on Polygon Mumbai, manages credential minting and verification
components.ipfs: IPFS Storage: Stores actual credential files (PDFs, images) with content-addressed hashes
components.database: PostgreSQL Database: Caches frequently accessed data and stores user sessions

contract.title: Smart Contract
contract.description: The core of TrustDegree is an ERC-721 smart contract deployed on Polygon Mumbai. It implements soulbound token functionality (non-transferable NFTs) for academic credentials.

functions.issueDegree: issueDegree(address to, string studentName, string degreeType, string ipfsHash) - Called by university admin (onlyOwner) to mint a new credential
functions.getDegree: getDegree(uint256 tokenId) - Public view function to retrieve credential metadata
functions.ownedBy: ownedBy(address owner) - Inherited from ERC721 - used to verify token ownership

contract.note: Note: This is a simplified example. Production contract includes additional access control, events, and security measures.
